slice: observe options validation/implicit-enable + textContent childList semantics + registered-text-node editing

fixes.options_validation: MO.observe validates options per spec: all of childList/attributes/characterData absent throws TypeError; attributeOldValue=true with attributes!==true throws; attributeFilter present with attributes!==true throws; characterDataOldValue likewise.
fixes.implicit_enable: attributeOldValue/attributeFilter/characterDataOldValue present (non-undefined) implicitly enable attributes/characterData observation (WPT sanity 'attributeOldValue true and attributes omitted should not throw').
fixes.filter_no_oldvalue: oldValue is provided only when attributeOldValue === true — attributeFilter alone filters records but does not request old values (WPT attributes 'attributeFilter alone' expects null). _mo_obs_wants_attr_old tightened.
fixes.textcontent_semantics: textContent= per spec: same-value no-op (comparison BEFORE the host write — latest-wins already contains the new value after writing, which made the first gate always-true and broke takeRecords; also local registered text first, since firstChild.data= edits only touch local state + SetChildText pending); different value emits childList (removed=old children snapshot, added=[new text node]) and NOT characterData (characterData records come only from text-node edits — R3027's characterData-for-textContent removed). firstChild immediately visible via the canvas _zwRegisterTextEl registry (firstChild/lastChild now consume _zwLocalChildNodes like childNodes already did).
fixes.registered_node_editing: _zwRegisterTextEl nodes (built by textContent=/innerHTML=) gain data/nodeValue setters + appendData/insertData/deleteData/replaceData/substringData — writes go through __zw_set_child_text (index 0) and emit characterData records via a new global hook __zw_mo_notify_text (part01 exports _mo_notify for the part06 top-level scope). characterData record target = the text node itself.
fixes.setchildtext_fallbacks: apply-side: SetChildText with out-of-range child_index falls back to parent set_text_content (equivalent for single-text-child semantics); SetChildText joined rewrite_pending_id_selectors (same-batch id renames now rewrite its parent_selector too).
fixes.legacy_test_updates: R3025/R3027/R3028 tests locked the old pragmatic semantics (filter-implied oldValue, characterData-for-textContent); updated to the R49 spec semantics (childList records, null oldValue without explicit request, characterData-only observers receive 0 records for textContent=).
in_round_regressions: same-value gate initially read _tcCur AFTER the host write (latest-wins already contained the new value → always-same → registration skipped → firstChild null again) — moved before the write
same-value on a locally-edited node: gate must read the local registered text first (data= edits don't show in element-level latest-wins)

mo_family_progress: R45-R49 cumulative: attributes 40P/0F, characterData 19P/0F, sanity 16P/0F, takeRecords 3P/0F (four at 100%), childList 18P/1F (remaining = deferred sibling-visibility M1 L2); dom/nodes 2507 -> 2579 (+72 over five rounds).
remaining: MutationObserver-document (parser-time mutations — deep structure), inner-outer (addedNodes ordering), disconnect (1F).
